# GitHub Configuration

GitHub-specific configuration for the Klugminds website repository.

## Contents

| Path                                                 | Purpose                                       |
| ---------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| [workflows/ci.yml](workflows/ci.yml)                 | CI — lint, type-check, build on PR and `main` |
| [ISSUE_TEMPLATE/](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/)                   | Structured issue forms for bugs and features  |
| [PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md](PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md) | Default pull request description template     |

## Issue Templates

- **Bug Report** — defects in website, CI, or tooling
- **Feature Request** — new pages, components, or capabilities

Documentation issues belong in [klugminds-handbook](https://github.com/klugminds/klugminds-handbook).

## Related Documentation

- [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) — contribution workflow
- [klugminds-handbook → docs/engineering](https://github.com/klugminds/klugminds-handbook/blob/main/docs/engineering/README.md) — engineering practices
